If you bought a private server, Press F2 for admin
DISCLAIMER!!!!! : This is a test place for stress testing systems, many things like: Maps, Qol, Gui, etc are unfinished or placeholders.

This large-scale FPS throws up to 80 players into a world on the brink. Experience intense team-based action, fight through destructible environments, and deploy with unique weapons and specialized equipment.

Pushing the Roblox engine to its limits.

⚠️ EARLY ALPHA — This experience is still heavily unfinished. Expect missing content, bugs, and major changes as development continues.

All scenarios and events depicted are fictional and do not represent real historical events.
